Tessa / team — forwarding BrightSide ask plus Tessa's draft. Quick internal notes:

1) The 7% additional commit discount on top of pilot credits pushes the blended price near the floor for our V100-backed dedicated pools. We can do it only if they sign a 12-month 6M token commit OR a $120k/month minimum (whichever is higher). Recommend adding a minimum annualized commitment clause.

2) Week 6 ramp credit as "one-time equal to 10% of 6-week consumption" is fine, but tie it to both throughput (5k req/day) AND quality metric (generation accuracy threshold from their eval set). This prevents gaming the checkpoint.

3) Add a clause for partial credits if they hit 75-90% of the ramp metric (pro-rated credit).

4) We should avoid guaranteeing expedited onboarding unless legal confirms scope of data handling — propose "expedited onboarding subject to executed SOW and completed security questionnaire".

Marissa / Karthik — any concerns on SLA exposure or marketplace listing impacts?

Best,
